sourceRecord.selectionBasis: New output has a continuous matching-SHA complete-base and native-patch chain to sixteen native source coordinates, no layout fill or upscaling. Local repair scope and pending art acceptance do not make the image partially generated.

issues.description: Central and outer lantern gold ribs and red outer silhouette are continuous in selected local composites and final x1024/y3072 junction.
Original red post gap remains. Both returned edits widened lower post and created new transfer-end steps; neither post edit selected.
Rectangular cyan roof step removed; fixed front roll ends continue coherently. Final x1024/y2048 actual junction viewed. Small goldbeam texture/value finish transition remains pending.
Roof collar floats/tapers and lower collar duplicates/merges near x2048. p02_02 has two native repair returns; first repair retained as best with explicit failure, per disposition record.

Actual 100pct central junction re-viewed: short brown segment aligns behind the golden upright and may be a legitimate wooden joint, not confirmed erroneous blue fascia. Keep original and finish/material review pending; no invented recolor.

Hard W-collar and roof-ground edge notch removed; short edge tube gets its own rounded collar. Its contact with wider upper tube remains ambiguous, so no topology pass; best second return retained. Final x3072/y1024 actual junction viewed.
Tall foliage changes abruptly to flat grass near upper curb. Main stone paving lines continue; small leaf/grass finish requires later review.

sourceRecord.qaSummaryMeaning: Producer status only; importing this complete generated tile is not whole-map or runtime visual acceptance.
sourceRecord.formalAcceptanceScope: Any source formalAccepted value applies only to its original pinned neighbor set; whole map remains unaccepted.
